        # localize with is_dst array element

        utc_vals[i] = localized.astimezone(pytz.UTC).value  # .value returns ns since epoch UTC.
    new_dates = utc_vals.view(_NS_DTYPE)
    return self._shallow_copy(new_dates, tz=tz)
